109	class Plane:
110	    """The execution plane: what the model can do to the world, and the record of it."""
111	
112	    def __init__(self, root: Path, hidden: tuple[str, ...] = HIDDEN):
113	        self.root = root.resolve()
114	        self.hidden = hidden
115	        self.listed: list[str] = []
116	        self.read_paths: list[str] = []
117	        self.lines_read = 0
118	
119	    def _resolve(self, path: str) -> tuple[Path, str]:
120	        p = (self.root / (path or ".")).resolve()
121	        if p != self.root and self.root not in p.parents:
122	            raise ValueError(f"outside the world: {path}")
123	        rel = p.relative_to(self.root).as_posix() or "."
124	        if rel.split("/", 1)[0] in self.hidden:
125	            raise ValueError(f"not part of the world: {path}")
126	        return p, rel
127	
128	    def list(self, path: str = ".") -> str:
129	        """List one directory of the world: one entry per line as kind, size, path. Path is
130	        relative to the world root; '.' is the root.
131	
132	        Args:
133	            path: The directory to list, relative to the world root.
134	        """
135	        try:
136	            p, rel = self._resolve(path)
137	            if not p.is_dir():
138	                raise ValueError(f"not a directory: {path}")
139	            entries = sorted(p.iterdir(), key=lambda e: (not e.is_dir(), e.name))
140	            if rel == ".":
141	                entries = [e for e in entries if e.name not in self.hidden]
142	            lines = []
143	            for e in entries[:LIST_CAP]:
144	                kind = "link" if e.is_symlink() else "dir" if e.is_dir() else "file"
145	                size = e.lstat().st_size if kind == "file" else 0
146	                lines.append(f"{kind}\t{size}\t{e.relative_to(self.root).as_posix()}")
147	            if len(entries) > LIST_CAP:
148	                lines.append(f"...\t{len(entries) - LIST_CAP} more entries not shown")
149	        except (ValueError, OSError) as e:
150	            return f"error: {e}"
151	        self.listed.append(rel)
152	        return "\n".join(lines) or "(empty)"
153	
154	    def read(self, path: str, start: int = 1) -> str:
155	        """Read a file of the world as numbered lines, from line `start` (1-based), at most 300
156	        lines or 32000 bytes per call; a truncated read says where to continue.
157	
158	        Args:
159	            path: The file to read, relative to the world root.
160	            start: The first line to read, 1-based.
161	        """
162	        try:
163	            p, rel = self._resolve(path)
164	            if not p.is_file():
165	                raise ValueError(f"not a file: {path}")
166	            start = max(1, int(start))
167	            out: list[str] = []
168	            n = nbytes = 0
169	            with p.open("r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
170	                for i, line in enumerate(f, 1):
171	                    if i < start:
172	                        continue
173	                    size = len(line.encode())
174	                    if n >= READ_LINES_CAP or nbytes + size > READ_BYTES_CAP:
175	                        out.append(f"...\ttruncated; continue with start={i}")
176	                        break
177	                    out.append(f"{i}\t{line.rstrip(chr(10))}")
178	                    n += 1
179	                    nbytes += size
180	        except (ValueError, OSError) as e:
181	            return f"error: {e}"
182	        self.read_paths.append(rel)
183	        self.lines_read += n
184	        return "\n".join(out) or "(empty)"

187	class Wire:
188	    """The raw HTTP record: one line per attempt, request and response, without the key."""
189	
190	    def __init__(self, path: Path):
191	        self.path = path
192	        self.attempts = 0
193	        path.touch()
194	        self.client = httpx2.AsyncClient(
195	            event_hooks={"request": [self.on_request], "response": [self.on_response]}
196	        )
197	
198	    def _write(self, **entry: Any) -> None:
199	        with self.path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
200	            f.write(json.dumps({"t": round(time.time(), 3), **entry}, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
201	
202	    async def on_request(self, request: Any) -> None:
203	        """Every attempt the SDK makes, body included; headers (and the key) are never written."""
204	        self.attempts += 1
205	        try:
206	            body = request.content.decode("utf-8", "replace")
207	        except Exception:  # a streamed body has nothing to record
208	            body = ""
209	        self._write(dir="request", method=request.method, url=str(request.url), status=None, body=body)
210	
211	    async def on_response(self, response: Any) -> None:
212	        """The answer to it, read in full so the body is there even when the SDK streams."""
213	        await response.aread()
214	        req = response.request
215	        self._write(
216	            dir="response",
217	            method=req.method,
218	            url=str(req.url),
219	            status=response.status_code,
220	            body=response.text,
221	        )
